primary_artifact: /Users/kmfp/HMI-Library-backup/heavy-metal-index-raw/Manual Fetch Kimi /07_Processed_Foods_Snacks_Beverages/07_Processed_Foods_Snacks_Beverages/Determination of Some Heavy Metals and Elements in Honeybee and Honey Samples from Saudi Arabia.pdf
disposition_reason: Primary apiary sampling study reporting Cd, Cr, Ni and Pb in honey from four Saudi agricultural regions (mg/L); Cd and Pb printed as 0.000 everywhere, Cr and Ni quantified only in Al-Baha.
disposition_locator: Honey concentration table (text 'Table 3'), p. 5; Results 2.1, p. 4; Methods p. 2–3

study.design: apiary sampling (paired honeybee and honey from same hive cells)
study.material_scope: Honey taken from beehive cells (Apis mellifera jemenatica); floral type not reported
study.growing_origin_vs_market: Growing origin: Jazan (Sabya), Asir (Abha), Al-Baha (Al Mandaq), Makkah (Taif), Saudi Arabia; collected directly from hives, not purchased.
study.sampling_unit: honey samples per region analysed in three replicates (number of hives/samples per region not stated)
study.method: Methods state 'wet microwave digestion' but describe 5 g sample ashed then calcined 13 h at 450 °C, ash dissolved in 10 mL 0.5 M HNO3, filtered (US EPA 1983); ICP-OES Varian 720-ES; Merck 1000 ppm standards
study.basis: mg/L honey (as printed); basis (w/v vs w/w, fresh) not explained
study.qa: Accuracy said to be verified with CRMs INCY-TL-1 (tea leaves) and NIST SRM 1515 (apple leaves); no CRM results or recoveries reported. Three replicates; SD and Std. Error tables.

findings.censoring: Printed as '0.000 ± 0.000' and described in text as 'not present' / 'free of any contamination'. No LOD/LOQ reported, so the censoring bound is unknown. Not imputed as zero.
findings.locator: Honey table (mean ± SD; referred to as Table 3 in text), row Cd, column Jazan; p. 5; text p. 4 section 2.1
findings.notes: Jazan region (Sabya), 17°09′N 42°38′E, Saudi Arabia; honey from beehives in agricultural area, collected March 2017; Apis mellifera jemenatica. Unit is mg/L as printed; not converted to µg/kg because a mg/L→mg/kg conversion needs honey density, which the source does not give (pure unit arithmetic is impossible). Paired honeybee-body values (Table 1, mg/g) are context only: Cd, Cr, Ni, Pb printed as 0.000 ± 0.000 in bees for all four regions. Dry ashing at 450 °C for 13 h may volatilize Cd and Pb (context, not stated by author).

controls.control: Implement a 'good beekeeping practices' guide (standardized beekeeping techniques) via authorities and beekeeper organizations
controls.outcome: Recommendation to maintain low contamination; not tested.

controls.control: Iron beekeeping tools / steel foundation wire as a source of Fe
controls.comparator: None in this study (cites Wagoner & Rueppell 2017 on brood, not honey)
controls.outcome: Author attributes Fe dominance in bee and honey samples to iron tools (cages, honey sorting); Fe is outside the HMI analyte list. No measured effect on Pb/Cd/Ni/Cr.

controls.control: Avoid placing hives near unsuitable urban areas
controls.outcome: Cited (ref. 5) as main source of honey contamination; not tested.

contradictions_with_stored_summary: Summary gives Al-Baha honey Cr as '0.1599 ± 0.000'; the honey table cell reads '0.159 ± 0.000' (0.1599 appears only in the Results text, p. 4).
Summary gives Al-Baha honey Cu as ND; the table prints '0.000 ± 0 .001' (SD non-zero with zero mean).

Summary describes the method as dry-ashing only; the primary Methods first say 'wet microwave digestion system' and then describe dry ashing at 450 °C — the primary is internally inconsistent and the summary does not flag it.

Summary labels the honey table 'Table 3 (honey, mg/L)'; in the PDF the caption under that table reads 'Table 3. Element concentration (mg/g) in honeybee samples analyzed by Standard error' — captions appear misaligned; the honey-table attribution relies on the text references.
Summary frontmatter sample_n: 8 (region × matrix cells) is not a sample count; the primary does not state how many honey samples were taken per region.

Summary says the author 'does not report... method validation against the certified reference materials'; the primary says accuracy was verified with CRMs but gives no results — consistent in substance.
Summary's caveat on volatilization during 450 °C dry ashing is the summary's own inference, not stated in the primary.
unresolved: Unit: honey results are printed in mg/L; whether this is mg per litre of digest, per litre of honey, or a mislabel for mg/kg is not explained. No µg/kg conversion was made.
Number of honey samples per region (and whether results represent one sample in triplicate) is not stated; n left null and sample_values left empty.
No LOD/LOQ reported; '0.000 ± 0.000' non-detects have no known censoring bound.
Methods say 'wet microwave digestion' but describe dry ashing at 450 °C.
Cr Al-Baha: table 0.159 vs text 0.1599 mg/L.
Sampling statement 'collected 50 (mg/g) of bees and 20 (mg/L) of honey' is garbled; amount collected unclear.
Table captions in the PDF text layer are misaligned (honey table caption says mg/g honeybee); attribution of the mg/L table to honey follows the Results text and Fig. 4 caption.
Cu, Fe, Mn, Zn and Ca, K, Mg, Na also reported but outside the HMI analyte list; honeybee-body values (Table 1, mg/g) are not honey and are excluded.
